name: Bombs vs Bots
storyline:
Bombs vs Bots is a chaotic action game featuring physics-based destruction and light environmental puzzles.

Cola Corp recently purchased a new building to serve as their next headquarters. In a bid to cut costs, they began replacing their workforce with AI-powered bots - a decision that backfired spectacularly before construction was even finished. The bots gained independence, barricaded the unfinished site, and began tearing it apart in search of GPUs to make themselves more powerful.

Now, as Cola Corp's most trusted support engineer, it's your job to clean up the mess. Fight your way through each floor, outsmart rogue machines, face off against boss encounters with unique mechanics, and turn every corridor into a fireworks display of shrapnel, sparks and debris.
summary: Bombs vs Bots is a chaotic action game featuring physics-based destruction and light environmental puzzles. As a support engineer for Cola Corp, you are tasked with defeating an army of AI-powered bots that have taken over the company's new headquarters.
